selectedFunctions.label: UltraYield cancelRedeemRequest financial accounting
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory; zero native value required.

Ethereum UltraYield ETH own CompliantUltraVault accounting only, not the external Midas vaults listed by the same frontend. Primary API marks ownership=internal and status=active. Current EIP-1967 implementation is 0x0abec1563628201e2e806670d7a26e587c3aabcf. Explorer grades proxy Similar Match and implementation Exact Match; no proxy exact-match claim. Observed paused()=false is point-in-time only. Upgrades, fee configuration, oracle, rate provider, funds holder, exitpoint and freeze registry are mutable.

Deposit/mint pull only msg.sender ERC20 funds directly to fundsHolder, then mint shares to receiver. WETH base asset and shares use 18 decimals; other asset inputs use their own native units and the configured fixed conversion interface. Deposits floor share output; exact-share mints round asset input up. There is no caller minShares, maxAssets or deadline on these methods. Referral bytes32 is event metadata, not executable calldata.

Vault share pricing comes from an externally supplied oracle, not the vault token balance. Management/performance fee collection mints dilution shares before deposits, mints, instant redemption and operator fulfillment; withdrawal fees and instant premium reduce payouts. Assets may be allocated off-chain or across other chains by the funds holder; these dependencies and financial backing are not independently attested here.

RequestRedeem requires caller to be owner/controller or an already-authorized operator for both, and separately spends owner allowance to this vault. It escrows shares to vault and records a controller-and-asset pending claim. Catalog grants no approval or operator authority. Requests have no price/minimum output bound, and are not automatically fulfilled; protocol operator must fund/fulfill with fundsHolder allowance. autoClaim preference is last-writer-wins for the shared controller/asset slot and, when true, fulfillment sends to controller.

CancelRedeemRequest returns all pending shares for the asset/controller to receiver, subject to controller access. Withdraw/redeem claim only already-fulfilled ledger balances, not live ERC4626 direct exits; caller must be controller or existing operator and may choose receiver. Claims and requests/cancellation are not gated by whenNotPaused, but compliance still applies. Partial asset withdrawals round shares up; partial share redemptions round assets down. Full recorded balance settles exactly; exhausting either side clears both and may retain a sub-share asset remainder in vault.

InstantRedeem burns controller shares and pays net selected ERC20 from configured instant exitpoint, limited to min(exitpoint balance, allowance). minAssets bounds net proceeds, but available liquidity, oracle, fees and compliance can change. Gross asset conversion and fees round down. No instant-liquidity or complete exit guarantee is made.

Compliant variant gates share transfers/mints by effective local/shared freeze registry and gates claimant receiver/controller. Deposit also gates caller. Freezes, mutable external dependencies or a frozen fee recipient can block otherwise ordinary financial calls. Privileged forceBurn, freeze/role/address/upgrades, operator fulfillment/cancellation, token approvals/transfers and all view/pure functions are excluded.

     * NOTE: This calculation MAY NOT reflect the “per-user” price-per-share, and instead should reflect the
     * “average-user’s” price-per-share, meaning what the average user should expect to see when exchanging to and
     * from.

require(shares != 0, NothingToRedeem());\\n        require(balanceOf(controller) \u003e= shares, InsufficientBalance());\\n\\n        \/\/ Collect accrued fees before processing (consistent with deposits and fulfillRedeem)\\n        _collectFees();\\n\\n        \/\/ Prepare instant redeem amounts\\n        (uint256 grossAssets, uint256 fee, uint256 netAssets) = _previewInstantRedeem(_asset, shares);\\n        require(netAssets != 0, NothingToWithdraw());\\n\\n        \/\/ Slippage protection — bound caller\u0027s worst-case received amount\\n        if (netAssets \u003c minAssets) {\\n (grossAssets \u003e availableLiquidity) {\\n            revert InsufficientLiquidity(_asset, grossAssets, availableLiquidity);\\n        }\\n\\n        \/\/ Burn shares from controller\\n        _burn(controller, shares);\\n\\n        \/\/ Transfer net assets to receiver\\n        address exitpoint = instantRedeemExitpoint();\\n        IERC20(_asset).safeTransferFrom(exitpoint, receiver, ) external override onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) returns (uint256[] memory) {\\n        \/\/ Check input length\\n        uint256 length = assets.length;\\n        require(length == shares.length \u0026\u0026 length == controllers.length, InputLengthMismatch());\\n\\n        \/\/ Collect fees accrued to date\\n        _collectFees();\\n\\n        \/\/ Prepare values for calculations\\n        uint256 totalShares;\\n        uint256 sharePrice = _getSharePrice();\\n        uint256 withdrawalFeeRate = getFees().withdrawalFee;\\n        uint256[] memory result = new uint256[](length);\\n address _controller = controllers[i];\\n            uint256 underlyingAssets = _optimizedConvertToAssets(_shares, sharePrice);\\n            uint256 convertedAssets = convertFromUnderlying(_asset, notes: Deposit/mint pull only msg.sender ERC20 funds directly to fundsHolder, then mint shares to receiver. WETH base asset and shares use 18 decimals; other asset inputs use their own native units and the configured fixed conversion interface. Deposits floor share output; exact-share mints round asset input up. There is no caller minShares, maxAssets or deadline on these methods. Referral bytes32 is event metadata, not executable calldata.

Vault share pricing comes from an externally supplied oracle, not the vault token balance. Management/performance fee collection mints dilution shares before deposits, mints, instant redemption and operator fulfillment; withdrawal fees and instant premium reduce payouts. Assets may be allocated off-chain or across other chains by the funds holder; these dependencies and financial backing are not independently attested here.

RequestRedeem requires caller to be owner/controller or an already-authorized operator for both, and separately spends owner allowance to this vault. It escrows shares to vault and records a controller-and-asset pending claim. Catalog grants no approval or operator authority. Requests have no price/minimum output bound, and are not automatically fulfilled; protocol operator must fund/fulfill with fundsHolder allowance. autoClaim preference is last-writer-wins for the shared controller/asset slot and, when true, fulfillment sends to controller.

CancelRedeemRequest returns all pending shares for the asset/controller to receiver, subject to controller access. Withdraw/redeem claim only already-fulfilled ledger balances, not live ERC4626 direct exits; caller must be controller or existing operator and may choose receiver. Claims and requests/cancellation are not gated by whenNotPaused, but compliance still applies. Partial asset withdrawals round shares up; partial share redemptions round assets down. Full recorded balance settles exactly; exhausting either side clears both and may retain a sub-share asset remainder in vault.

InstantRedeem burns controller shares and pays net selected ERC20 from configured instant exitpoint, limited to min(exitpoint balance, allowance). minAssets bounds net proceeds, but available liquidity, oracle, fees and compliance can change. Gross asset conversion and fees round down. No instant-liquidity or complete exit guarantee is made.

Compliant variant gates share transfers/mints by effective local/shared freeze registry and gates claimant receiver/controller. Deposit also gates caller. Freezes, mutable external dependencies or a frozen fee recipient can block otherwise ordinary financial calls. Privileged forceBurn, freeze/role/address/upgrades, operator fulfillment/cancellation, token approvals/transfers and all view/pure functions are excluded.
